name: New River Gorge National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed on all trails.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed on all trails.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed on all trails at New River Gorge National Park and Preserve.

dogRules.text: No pets in park buildings, visitor centers or ranger-led programs.
Bring water for your pet; streams may carry Giardia and trailheads have no drinking water.
Dogs can become B.A.R.K. Rangers at any visitor center.
Dogs can join the 100 Mile Challenge.
